designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1961 under the Fish and Wildlife Coordination Act on the upper end of the Bureau of Reclamation's Foss Reservoir, as a resting and feeding area for migrating waterfowl.

authority.citation: Fish and Wildlife Coordination Act (overlay of Bureau of Reclamation land)

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Washita National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Encyclopedia of Oklahoma History and Culture: Washita National Wildlife Refuge ("Created in 1961 on the northwest portion of the Foss Reservoir")
FWS news release, Apr. 27, 1961: Secretary Udall announced the new Washita National Wildlife Refuge at Foss Reservoir

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Washita National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1961 under the Fish & Wildlife Coordination Act primarily to provide a resting and feeding area for migrating and wintering waterfowl.
